dict.string: Bothive uses the microphone for hands-free voice conversations with your Bots.
Bothive uses speech recognition to turn what you say into messages for your Bots.
Bothive shares only the selected Bot’s UTM virtual machine window with your approved devices when you enable remote VM viewing.
Bothive uses UTM to create and open a separate Linux virtual machine for each Bot when you choose VM setup, and reads Mail and Notes for your Bots only when you turn those on in Apple connections.
Bothive lets your Bots see your upcoming events, and add events you approve, only when you turn Calendar on in Apple connections.

Bothive lets your Bots see your reminders, and add reminders you approve, only when you turn Reminders on in Apple connections.
